exceptions.reason: Prisma 6 configuration CLI path; requires a cyclic object graph. Application does not import deepmerge/config APIs or accept untrusted Prisma config. Package may still be installed through peer dependencies; this is an execution-reachability disposition, not an absence claim. Prisma 7 upgrade requires its own compatibility migration.
exceptions.invalidateOn: Untrusted configuration, dynamic Prisma config execution in the API, direct deepmerge imports, changed versions or a new advisory.

exceptions.reason: Current app uses createRoot + BrowserRouter in declarative SPA mode, not SSR hydration. The advisory excludes declarative mode. Compatible 6.30.6 update applied; major 7 migration is separate.
exceptions.invalidateOn: SSR/hydrateRoot/data-router introduction, changed versions or a new advisory.

exceptions.reason: Conditional navigation risk remains in router 6. Supported return-location producer is internal ProtectedRoute state; no external returnUrl is currently accepted. Not a universal safety claim. Keep external navigation disabled and review a router 7 migration separately.
exceptions.invalidateOn: External returnUrl/deep-link destination input, untrusted location state, changed versions or a new advisory.
